## Settings

Users can configure several default settings of the Balance Explorer.

- **Default Date Range** - Set the default [Date Selector](Balance%20Explorer_Date%20Selector.md) option. Options are:
  - Current Month
  - Previous Month
  - Both Current And Previous Month

- **Show L&U data in Member View data grid** - When this option is enabled, L&U and L&U % rows are added to the Member Viewer data grid the L&U Viewer panel is hidden.

  If you then turn on L&U Viewer from the Panels drop-down, L&U information will display in both the L&U Viewer and Member Viewer.

  If you are using the Recovery Analysis template, it is best to display the L&U grid as these values are calculated only in the L&U grid.

- **Load data when window opens** - When this option is enabled, the data grids will automatically load based on pre-selected templates, location, and other related options.

- **Show Location Rollup Queue panel** - When this option is enabled, the Location Rollup Queue panel will display under the Location Explorer panel.

- **Default Template** - Select a default template to load when the Balance Explorer is launched.

- **Default Conditions** - Switch between measured and standard conditions for applicable variables.

- **Default Decimals** - Set default decimal places for the following categories: Gas and Liquid Volumes, Energy, Mass, Temperature, Pressure, Heating Value, Density, Meter and K-Factors, Correction Factors, Components, L&U Percentage.
